subtitle: Feedback for websites, shops and events
description:
Put a feedback button on your website with one script tag, or a QR code on your tables, counter or event badges. People send praise, problems and ideas from their phone, with a photo in one tap and an email if they'd like a reply.

Each project gets a page of its own with your title, logo and cover, a custom address and a poster to print. Anyone can vote for what others asked and comment; comments wait for your approval.

Everything arrives in one inbox per project. Sort it by status, keep private notes, and see how many people scanned, visited and sent something.
whatsNew: Made for places and events: Praise, Problem and Idea, a one-tap camera button, and a page with your title, logo and cover. Stats count QR scans and email visits, and Share can email the link.
